.name: Change Steam wishlist
.note: Add or remove games from the signed-in Steam account's wishlist after confirming the AppIDs and action in chat. Open a signed-in Steam game store page first. Each change is checked against the wishlist.
.description: Add or remove games from the signed-in Steam account's wishlist after confirming the AppIDs and action in chat. Open a signed-in Steam game store page first. Each change is checked against the wishlist.
.parameters.appIds: List of integer Steam AppIDs to change. Use Steam store search to identify AppIDs from game names.
.parameters.operation: Use add to add games to the wishlist or remove to take them off.
